segments.exact:
Quinton: "Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships. We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate."

circumstance.context: Deployment gate decision for the Meridian release train, 2026-07-02

segments.note: Direct quote; unified voice, no footing case. First sentence states the new rule, second gives its rationale — kept as one assertive move.
